publications.title: Margin Requirements for Uncleared Swaps: Phase Six Threshold Recalibration
publications.summary: The CFTC has adopted final amendments recalibrating the material swaps exposure threshold for uncleared margin requirements, with staged compliance dates for newly in-scope entities and revised documentation timing rules.

publications.title: Consultation on CCP Recovery and Resolution Toolkits — Second Consultation
publications.summary: ESMA is consulting on enhancements to central counterparty recovery toolkits, including variation margin gains haircutting, cash calls and partial tear-up mechanics, ahead of technical standards under the CCP Recovery and Resolution Regulation.

publications.title: UPI and UTI Implementation Guidance for Reporting Entities
publications.summary: The FCA has published updated guidance for trade reporting counterparties on unique product identifier and unique transaction identifier generation, pairing logic and error remediation expectations under UK EMIR.

publications.title: Proposed Expansion of the Clearing Obligation to Additional IRS Classes
publications.summary: MAS proposes extending the clearing obligation to additional interest rate swap classes denominated in regional currencies, with a phased implementation aligned to international timelines and an intragroup exemption renewal.

publications.title: Thematic Review of OTC Derivatives Trade Reporting Data Quality
publications.summary: ASIC has released findings from its thematic review of derivative transaction reporting, identifying recurring reconciliation breaks and setting supervisory expectations for remediation programs at reporting entities.

publications.title: Holistic Review of Margining Practices: Final Report
publications.summary: The FSB, jointly with BCBS, CPMI and IOSCO, has published its final report on margining practices in centrally and non-centrally cleared markets, with policy proposals on margin transparency, liquidity preparedness and procyclicality.

publications.title: Good Practices for Cross-Border Supervisory Deference in Derivatives Markets
publications.summary: IOSCO sets out good practices for deference arrangements between derivatives regulators, covering comparability assessments, ongoing monitoring and cooperation triggers when regimes diverge.

publications.title: Capital Treatment of Cleared Derivatives Exposures: SA-CCR Refinements
publications.summary: The Basel Committee proposes targeted refinements to the standardised approach for counterparty credit risk affecting cleared derivatives exposures, including recalibrated supervisory factors for certain asset classes.

publications.title: Enforcement Action for Swap Data Reporting Failures by a Registered Dealer
publications.summary: The SEC announced a settled enforcement action against a security-based swap dealer for systemic reporting and recordkeeping failures, imposing a civil penalty and remediation undertakings.

publications.title: Regulatory Perimeter for Crypto-Asset Derivatives: Discussion Paper
publications.summary: The DFSA invites feedback on the treatment of crypto-asset derivatives within its regulatory perimeter, including margin, disclosure and custody implications for authorised firms in the DIFC.

publications.title: Recognition of Close-Out Netting in Resolution Frameworks: Updated Guidance
publications.summary: The JFSA has updated its guidance on the recognition of close-out netting and temporary stays in resolution, aligning documentation expectations with FSB key attributes for derivatives counterparties.

publications.title: Position Limits for Commodity Derivative Contracts: Amendments and Hedging Exemptions
publications.summary: The FCA has finalised amendments to its commodity derivatives position limits regime, narrowing the set of contracts in scope and streamlining the bona fide hedging exemption application process.
